name: recurrent-gae-trace-2026-10-25
hypothesis: Saved legacy selected/final value consistency differs across long observed and self-bootstrapped lambda targets; this does not establish causal bias. Compare one fixed lambda1 candidate with lambda0.95 control. Finite lambda1 returns telescope intermediate critic terms while increasing variance; no benefit assumed.

source_references.claim: Generalized advantage estimators trade estimator bias and variance; robotics evidence is not trading evidence.
Installed RecurrentPPO exposes gae_lambda; use unchanged maintained implementation.

sampling.group_rule: Choose ETF with probability4/26 and stock with probability22/26, independent of history/outcomes; then sample each group from a seeded shuffled episode deck without replacement until exhausted; uniformly choose a full512-transition window
sampling.episode_cycle: Shuffle each group again only after every member was drawn; no return/regime ranking
sampling.actual_logging: Per-symbol starts/transitions, group starts/transitions, dataset and normalization identities; report actual ETF mass, not just intended probability
sampling.budget_justification: Same accepted111-symbol history, group/deck/window sampler, original26 development panel and100k steps per arm. Only gae_lambda differs.

simulation: Unchanged default100000 capital,whole shares,exposure cap1,max holding20,costs/corporate actions/next-open/learned stops and target zone.

shared_initialization.contract: Exact common original full64 untrained policy tensors and per-seed CPU RNG across both arms and smoke; empty coupled Adam; verify seeded NumPy/Python equality. Changing lambda must not change initialization.

historical_control_reproduction.failure: Invalidate interpretation and promotion without widened tolerances or automatic retry.

screen_gate.failure: Close fixed GAE-trace comparison on failed screen. No lambda/gamma/rollout/minibatch/epoch/learning-rate/model/reward/feature/steps grid, schedules, extension, confirmation or promotion.

confirmation_gate.interpretation: Development gates only; a frozen prospective comparison remains required

actual_rollout_acceptance: Record finite actual buffer returns/advantages and reconstruct GAE for every rollout before optimization, respecting episode boundaries/time-limit reward bootstrap and last-value bootstrap. Candidate lambda1 return must match independently segmented discounted reward sums. Preserve selected/final model/Adam/restoration and at least78 frozen recurrent predictions per arm.
selection_metric: Unchanged equal-weight mean26-symbol development net return, selected and actual final post-update independently. Final test cannot select checkpoints.
short_side: Report long/short net PnL and costs; future declining-stock labels reporting-only. Require both positive total and positive net short PnL for profitable-short claims.

execution.concurrency: Configurable central fleet; original project ledger/lock and persistent gae-study baseline across smoke/screen/retries.
execution.cleanup: Retain/retrieve durably; verify every owned shutdown and release hash before duplicate cleanup; never stop unrelated sessions.

constraints: No new features, VIX/benchmark subtraction/reward shaping, source selection, retired2024+ prices, broker orders or rescue of closed families. This is estimator trace length, not a change to gamma or holding horizon. Only passing smoke and screen gates permit confirmation/prospective work.
